excerpt: How to Build Talent Communities for Faster and Smarter Recruitment Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Canadian employers increasingly look beyond borders to fill critical roles. However, international recruitment is governed by a complex web of regulations, including compliance with work permits, Labour Market Impact Assessments (LMIAs), and evolving employment laws. Failure to meet these requirements can result in costly penalties, reputational damage, and even bans from hiring foreign workers.
